disjointness_argument: every write's span is derived from (x, y) as [T*y + a : T*(y+1) - b] with 0 <= a, b < T, so it lies inside tile (y, x). Spans computed above: icon [1, 9), ones [6, 10), tens [2, 6) -- all within [0, 10).

per_cell_table.note: a flat (cell, value) table. The layered form above needs only the icon sprites plus 21 digit sprites, because a two-digit cell is icon + ones + tens with binary alphas -- the same stencil the world layer uses.

caps.inventory: clip_inventory_and_intrinsics: jnp.minimum(x, 99) over the whole Inventory
caps.consequence: counts are NOT capped at 9 as in Classic; a two-digit cell has 100 values
